findings.issue: Previously only had a single fixed 4000 Hz notch filter with no dynamics compressor or limiter, causing audio clipping during sharp dental tool clatter and severe dropouts for quiet far-field doctor speech.
findings.resolution: Extended DentalNoiseFilterOptions with dspProfile, enableTurbineNotch2 (6kHz), enableCompressor, and enableLimiter; inserted DynamicsCompressorNode and Limiter into the live Web Audio graph with runtime profile switching.

findings.issue: Absence of clinical presets, soft-clipping saturation guard, and signal-to-noise ratio estimation.
findings.resolution: Implemented 4 canonical clinical DSP presets (clean_studio, dental_balanced, far_field_boost, ultra_noise_rejection), tanh-based soft-clipping saturation guard, spectral noise gating, and calculateSnrDb / evaluateAcousticQuality.

findings.issue: check-css-tokens flagged undefined token --paper-hover with light fallback #e2e8f0.
findings.resolution: Replaced with canonical design system tokens var(--paper-subtle, var(--paper-soft)) and var(--paper-strong).
